notes.title: Miniatures release date set - the 14th of November!
notes.notes:
We can finally let you know that Miniatures will be out on Steam (PC, Mac, and Steam Deck), iOS, and Nintendo Switch on the 14th of November 💛

For those who haven't heard about the game before, Miniatures is a short story collection about how children experience the world. Play through four memories where reality interlaces with the magical, add a splash of eeriness and you're introduced to the world of Miniatures. 

You'll be able to play all four stories: Familiar, The Paludarium, The Last Sand Castle, and The House of the Moon 🪛🦎🐚🦋

See the styles of all four games here in our new trailer: 
[previewyoutube=RPRyJnYraqM;full][/previewyoutube]
Looking forward to hear what your favourite will be 💛

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428840/Miniatures/

~ The Others
